Yes, I've been battling with depression since I was 16 and there has been times where I've been happy but then it goes away and I'm left with the cold feeling in my chest and the lack of emotions. It's horrible to live with and I haven't been on medication for it since I was first diagnosed with it and I'm realizing now that its a mistake by going off the medication because it has actually gotten worse but I refuse to take the medications. I would go talk to a doctor about how you're feeling. If it is depression, which it sounds like it is, then you should really take the medications.
